title: GNNs Meet Sequence Models Along the Shortest-Path: an Expressive Method for Link Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2507.07138v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) often struggle to capture the link-specific structural patterns crucial for accurate link prediction, as their node-centric message-passing schemes overlook the subgraph structures connecting a pair of nodes. Existing methods to inject such structural context either incur high computational cost or rely on simplistic heuristics (e.g., common neighbor counts) that fail to model multi-hop dependencies. We introduce SP4LP (Shortest Path for Link Prediction), a novel framework that combines GNN-based node encodings with sequence modeling over shortest paths. Specifically, SP4LP first applies a GNN to compute representations for all nodes, then extracts the shortest path between each candidate node pair and processes the resulting sequence of node embeddings using a sequence model. translated_title: 图神经网络沿最短路径遇见序列模型：一种表达力强的链路预测方法
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）通常难以捕获对准确链路预测至关重要的链路特定结构模式，因为其以节点为中心的消息传递机制忽略了连接一对节点的子图结构。现有的注入此类结构上下文的方法要么计算成本高昂，要么依赖于无法建模多跳依赖关系的简单启发式方法（例如共同邻居计数）。我们提出了SP4LP（Shortest Path for Link Prediction，用于链路预测的最短路径），这是一种将基于GNN的节点编码与最短路径上的序列建模相结合的新颖框架。具体而言，SP4LP首先应用GNN计算所有节点的表示，然后提取每个候选节点对之间的最短路径，并使用序列模型处理所得的节点嵌入序列。这种设计使SP4LP能够以计算高效的方式捕获具有表达力的多跳关系模式。
tldr: SP4LP提出将图神经网络节点编码与最短路径上的序列建模相结合，能够以高效的方式捕获链路预测中表达力强的多跳关系模式。
en_tdlr: SP4LP combines GNN node encodings with sequence modeling over shortest paths, enabling computationally efficient capture of expressive multi-hop relational patterns for link prediction.
